correctness.rationale: The original graph discrete Morse faces are functional directed forests. Cyclic fixed points are realized by orbit barycenters; an admissible arrow orbit has distinct source/target permutation cycles with target length dividing source length and exactly the target length of phases. Acyclicity is equivalent upstairs/downstairs by the projection argument and finite phase closure. Reversing quotient arrows gives a complete source when a divisor-root length occurs; Jojić/Kozlov yields a pure shellable directed forest complex, and Moradi–Khosh-Ahang proves shellability survives independent phase cloning. The directed matrix–forest determinant factors in equal-length blocks, giving the exact face polynomial and the integer sphere count. The c=1 boundary has no arrow orbits. Fourteen cases were rebuilt from original directed-arrow orbits and checked against independent mod-two boundary ranks; these are corroboration only, not the unrestricted proof.

originality.rationale: The new asserted invariant is the actual geometric cyclic fixed-space shellability and complete integral homotopy type for divisor-rooted permutation cycle types, including incomparable longer lengths. A prior all-cycle-type equivariant matrix–forest paper already supplies the quotient and enumerator, so those are not claimed original. The cited complete-source and expansion theorems each supply known tools but do not themselves assert this fixed-space classification. Existing own prior claims only cover involutions and independent block-group actions, neither all synchronized divisor-rooted permutations. Checked statements do not explicitly or singly dominate the full homotopy theorem; the main risk is implicit derivability by combining prior tools.
residual_risks: A close reader could regard the homotopy conclusion as an implicit corollary of the prior matrix–forest quotient combined with classical complete-source and expansion shellability, despite its not being stated there.
Equivalent unindexed work in equivariant directed-forest topology may exist.
The theorem asserts no results for non-divisor-rooted cycle types or arbitrary subgroups.

value.rationale: The geometric fixed-space homotopy of a cyclic action is a natural topological invariant, distinct from a trace. This theorem gives a complete integral classification for a large infinite class of permutation cycle types of unbounded order and multiple incomparable nonminimal lengths, with a clean divisibility criterion, pure shellability and exact sphere multiplicity. The criterion supplies a structural reason for homology concentration rather than isolated tabulated values. Mathematical value is the full fixed-point homotopy statement, not the earlier determinant or its routine evaluations; no stronger general theorem is asserted.
